question: Must this authentication-boundary change include packaged macOS proof for background, explicit-refresh, and CLI web paths before merge?
rationale: The deterministic tests establish control flow but cannot demonstrate real Chromium Safe Storage and Keychain behavior or the user-visible upgrade impact on an affected installation.

options.title: Require packaged proof
options.body: Require redacted runtime evidence for background suppression plus preserved user-refresh and CLI web authentication before merging.

options.title: Accept deterministic coverage
options.body: Merge based on the central guard and override-based tests while explicitly accepting uncertainty in packaged upgrade and CLI behavior.

recommendation.title: Require packaged proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted runtime evidence for background suppression plus preserved user-refresh and CLI web authentication before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice governs the repository's Keychain consent boundary and acceptance standard for packaged macOS behavior.
